metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented the CLI tool in [output/main.cpp](/workspace/output/main.cpp) with [output/CMakeLists.txt](/workspace/output/CMakeLists.txt). It builds as required with `cmake -B build && cmake --build build`, producing `output/build/iges`.

The program now covers the fixed-format IGES reader/writer pipeline, canonical JSON parse/write/query output, DE/global validation and diagnostics, roundtrip emission, and evaluator support for the implemented parametric curve/surface paths in the contract. I verified the end-to-end `write -> parse -> eval -> roundtrip` flow on a minimal IGES line case, and the second roundtrip output was byte-identical to the first.
